paragraphs: In this report, the terms "Kingsway," the "Company," "we," "us" or "our" mean Kingsway Financial Services Inc. and all entities included in our Consolidated Financial Statements.

Kingsway Financial Services Inc. was incorporated under the Business Corporations Act (Ontario) on September 19, 1989. Effective December 31, 2018, the Company changed its jurisdiction of incorporation from the province of Ontario, Canada, to the State of Delaware. The Company's registered office is located at 10 S. Riverside Plaza, Suite 1520, Chicago, Illinois 60606. The common shares of Kingsway are listed on the NYSE under the trading symbol "KFS."

Kingsway is a holding company with operating subsidiaries located in the United States and is the only publicly-traded US company employing the Search Fund model to acquire and build great businesses. The Company owns and operates a collection of high-quality B2B and B2C services companies that are asset-light, growing, and that have recurring revenues. Kingsway seeks to compound long-term shareholder value on a per share basis via its decentralized management model, its talented team of operators, and its tax-advantaged corporate structure.

The Company owns or controls subsidiaries primarily in the business services and extended warranty industries. Kingsway conducts its business through two reportable segments - Kingsway Search Xcelerator and Extended Warranty - that conduct their business and distribute their products and services primarily in the United States.

Financial information about Kingsway's reportable business segments for the years ended December 31, 2025 and December 31, 2024 is contained in the following sections of this 2025 Annual Report: (i) Note 22, "Segmented Information," to the Consolidated Financial Statements; and (ii) "Results of Continuing Operations" section of MD&A.
All of the dollar amounts in this 2025 Annual Report are expressed in U.S. dollars. GENERAL DEVELOPMENT OF BUSINESS

On March 14, 2025, the Company acquired 100% of the outstanding membership interests of M.L.C. Plumbing, LLC (d/b/a Bud's Plumbing Service, "Bud's Plumbing"). Bud's Plumbing, based in Evansville, Indiana, is a provider of various plumbing installation, service and repair services to residential and commercial customers. Bud's Plumbing is included in the Kingsway Search Xcelerator segment.

The Company acquired Bud's Plumbing for aggregate consideration consisting of cash and a seller note, of approximately $5.0 million, less certain escrowed amounts for purposes of indemnification claims. The closing purchase price was paid with cash on hand. Further information is contained in Note 4, "Acquisitions," to the Consolidated Financial Statements.

On July 1, 2025, the Company acquired 100% of the outstanding equity interests of Roundhouse Electric & Equipment Co., Inc. ("Roundhouse"). Roundhouse, based in Odessa, Texas, is a provider of industrial-scale electric motor maintenance, repair, testing, and sales solutions primarily to midstream natural gas pipeline operators and utilities across the Permian Basin. Roundhouse is included in the Kingsway Search Xcelerator segment.

The Company acquired Roundhouse for aggregate consideration consisting of cash and phantom equity awards to the selling stockholders, of approximately $22.7 million, less certain escrowed amounts for purposes of indemnification claims. Further information is containe
," to the Consolidated Financial Statements.

The closing purchase price was financed with a combination of debt financing provided by Mainstreet Bank and cash on hand. Longhorns Acquisition LLC and Roundhouse, subsidiaries of Kingsway, borrowed a total of $11.0 million, in the form of a term loan, and established a $0.5 million revolver that was undrawn at close. The Roundhouse term loan requires monthly payments of principal and interest and has a variable interest rate equal to the greater of the one-month term Secured Overnight Financing Rate ("SOFR") plus 3.3%, or 5.0%. The Roundhouse term loan and revolver mature on July 1, 2035.

On August 1, 2025, the Company (through its newly formed subsidiary, Advanced Plumbing & Drain LLC) acquired substantially all of the assets and certain specified liabilities of AAA Flexible Pipe Cleaning Corporation (d/b/a AAA Advanced Plumbing & Drain, "Advanced Plumbing"). Advanced Plumbing, based in Cleveland, Ohio, is a provider of various plumbing installation, service and repair services to residential and commercial customers. Advanced Plumbing is included in the Kingsway Search Xcelerator segment.

The Company acquired Advanced Plumbing for aggregate consideration consisting of cash, a seller note and contingent consideration, of approximately $3.7 million, less certain escrowed amounts for purposes of indemnification claims. The closing purchase price was paid with cash on hand. Further information is contained in Note 4, "Acquisitions," to the Consolidated Financial Statements.

headings: We have outstanding recourse debt and acquisition financing, which could adversely affect our ability to obtain financing in the future, react to changes in our business and satisfy our obligations.
Increases in interest rates would increase the cost of servicing our outstanding recourse debt and could adversely affect our results of operation.
Our operations are restricted by the terms of our debt indentures, which could limit our ability to plan for or react to market conditions or meet our capital needs.
We may not be able to realize our investment objectives, which could significantly reduce our earnings and liquidity.

Our business, financial condition and results of operations could be materially and adversely affected by public health crises and changes in international and national economic and industry conditions.
Worldwide armed conflicts and the related implications may negatively impact our operations.
International trade policies, including tariffs, sanctions and trade barriers, may adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations and prospects.
Our cash, cash equivalents and investments could be adversely affected if the financial institutions in which we hold our cash, cash equivalents and investments fail.
We have generated net operating loss carryforwards for U.S. income tax purposes, but our ability to use these net operating losses could be limited by our inability to generate future taxable income.
We have generated U.S. NOLs, but our ability to preserve and use these U.S. NOLs could be limited or impaired by future ownership changes.
Expiration of our tax benefit preservation plan could increase the probability that we will experience an ownership change as defined under Section 382.

We will only be able to utilize our U.S. NOLs against the future taxable income generated by companies we acquire if we are able to include the acquired companies in our U.S. consolidated tax return group.
We have outstanding preferred stock with rights senior to our common stock, and may issue additional preferred stock in the future.
If we fail to comply with insurance, securities or other applicable laws or regulatory requirements, our business, results of operations, financial condition or cash flow could be adversely affected.
Our business is subject to risks related to litigation.
Material weaknesses in our internal control over financial reporting could result in material misstatements in our consolidated financial statements.
The achievement of our strategic objectives is highly dependent on effective change management.
We may experience difficulty continuing to retain our holding company staff.
The highly competitive environment in which we operate could have an adverse effect on our business, results of operations or financial condition.
Engaging in acquisitions involves risks, and, if we are unable to effectively manage these risks, our business could be materially harmed.
Our Extended Warranty subsidiaries' deferred service fees may be inadequate, which would result in a reduction in our net income and could adversely affect our financial condition.
Extended Warranty's reliance on credit unions and dealers, as well as our overall reliance on automobile sales could adversely affect our ability to maintain business.
Our reliance on a limited number of warranty and maintenance support clients and customers could adversely affect our ability to maintain business.
CSuite's focus on serving private equity backed businesses creates exposure to general mergers and acquisitions ("M&A") activity.
Ravix's concentration in venture-capital-funded startups creates exposure to the venture capital funding cycles.
SNS may experience increased costs that reduce its revenue and profitability if applicable government regulations change.
SNS' profitability could be adversely impacted if SNS is unable to adjust its nurse pay rates as the bill rates decline.
SNS may be unable to recruit and retain enough quality nurses to meet the demand.
Image Solutions may be unable to recruit and retain enough quality IT professionals to meet the demand.
Revenue and growth of certain of our business lines depend on sustained customer retention and repeat work; the loss of key customers or reduced repeat business could harm results.
Roundhouse faces regional and industry-specific risks given concentration in the Permian Basin and customer segment of midstream natural gas pipeline operators and utilities.
Roundhouse's business includes equipment sales that may be subject to supply chain constraints, delivery delays, and pricing pressures.
Roundhouse faces inherent health, safety, and operational risks associated with providing mission-critical field services at customer sites.
Our skilled trades operations involve inherent safety risks that could result in worker injuries, property damage, regulatory liabilities and increased operating costs.
Changes in the skilled trade customer demand or customer concentration in certain markets could adversely affect our results of operations.
Our success depends on our ability to price accurately the risks we underwrite.

Our business depends upon key employees, and if we are unable to retain the services of these key employees or to attract and retain additional qualified personnel, our business could be adversely affected.
paragraphs: Most issuers, including Kingsway, are exposed to numerous risk factors that could cause actual results to differ materially from recent results or anticipated future results. The risks and uncertainties described below are those specific to the Company that we currently believe have the potential to be material, but they may not be the only ones we face. If any of the following risks, or any other risks and uncertainties that we have not yet identified or that we currently consider not to be material, actually occur or become material risks, our business, prospects, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows could be materially and adversely affected. Investors are advised to consider these factors along with the other information included in this 2025 Annual Report and to consult any further disclosures Kingsway makes in its filings with the SEC.

paragraphs: The following management's discussion and analysis ("MD&A") of our financial condition and results of operations should be read together with the Consolidated Financial Statements included in Part II, Item 8 of this 2025 Annual Report.

Kingsway is a holding company with operating subsidiaries located in the United States. The Company is the only publicly-traded US company employing the Search Fund model to acquire and build great businesses and owns and operates a collection of high-quality B2B and B2C services companies that are asset-light, growing, profitable, and that have recurring revenues. Kingsway seeks to compound long-term shareholder value on a per share basis via its decentralized management model, its talented team of operators, and its tax-advantaged corporate structure. Kingsway conducts its business through two reportable segments: Kingsway Search Xcelerator and Extended Warranty.

Kingsway Search Xcelerator includes the Company's subsidiaries, CSuite Financial Partners, LLC ("CSuite"), Ravix Group, Inc. ("Ravix"), Secure Nursing Service LLC ("SNS"), Systems Products International, Inc. ("SPI"), Digital Diagnostics Inc. ("DDI"), Image Solutions, LLC ("Image Solutions"), Roundhouse Electric & Equipment Co., Inc. ("Roundhouse"), M.L.C. Plumbing, LLC (d/b/a Bud's Plumbing Service, "Bud's Plumbing"), Advanced Plumbing & Drain, LLC (d/b/a AAA Advanced Plumbing & Drain, "Advanced Plumbing") and Efficient Plumbing, LLC (d/b/a Southside Plumbing, "Southside Plumbing"). Throughout this 2025 Annual Report, the term "Kingsway Search Xcelerator" or "KSX" is used to refer to this segment.

CSuite is a professional services firm that provides experienced chief financial officer and other finance professionals to its clients through a variety of flexible offerings. These offerings include project, fractional, and interim staffing of senior finance professionals, CFO mentoring, board advisory services, and executive search services for permanent placements for its clients throughout the United States.

Ravix provides outsourced financial services and human resources consulting to its clients on a fractional basis for both projects with definitive endpoints and ongoing engagements of indeterminate length for short or long duration engagements for customers throughout the United States.
SNS provides healthcare staffing services to acute healthcare facilities on a contract or per diem basis in the United States, primarily in California.
SPI provides software products created exclusively to serve the management needs of all types of shared-ownership properties globally.

DDI provides outsourced 24 hours a day and 7 days per week ("24/7") cardiac telemetry services for general acute care, long-term acute care and inpatient rehabilitation hospitals. Outsourcing cardiac monitoring allows hospitals to eliminate personnel callouts and human resources issues, remove distractions from onsite operations, and free up facility staff to assist directly with patient care. DDI currently has a presence in

Image Solutions provides comprehensive information technology managed services, including equipment sales, service, and helpdesk support to customers primarily in North Carolina, Kansas, Georgia, Kentucky and Tennessee.

Roundhouse provides industrial-scale electric motor solutions, including field maintenance, in-shop repair, testing, and new motor sales primarily to midstream natural gas pipeline operators and utilities across the Permian Basin.

Kingsway Skilled Trades includes Bud's Plumbing, Advanced Plumbing and Southside Plumbing. Kingsway Skilled Trades provides a comprehensive range of plumbing services, including emergency repairs, drain cleaning, water heater installations, and water treatment solutions to residential and commercial customers, primarily in Evansville, Indiana (Bud's Plumbing), Cleveland, Ohio (Advanced Plumbing) and Omaha, Nebraska (Southside Plumbing).

Extended Warranty includes the following subsidiaries of the Company: IWS Acquisition Corporation ("IWS"), Geminus Holding Company, Inc. ("Geminus"), PWI Holdings, Inc. ("PWI") and Trinity Warranty Solutions LLC ("Trinity"). Throughout this 2025 Annual Report, the term "Extended Warranty" is used to refer to this segment.

IWS is a licensed motor vehicle service agreement company and is a provider of after-market vehicle protection services distributed by credit unions in 28 states and the District of Columbia to their members, with customers in all fifty states.

Geminus primarily sells vehicle service agreements to used car buyers across the United States, mainly through its subsidiary, The Penn Warranty Corporation ("Penn"). Penn distributes these products in 46 states via independent used car dealerships and franchised car dealerships.

paragraphs: 下列管理層討論與分析（"MD&A"）關於本公司財務狀況及營運成果之說明，應與本年度2025年財務報告第二部分，第8項所載之合併財務報表一併閱讀。

Kingsway為一家控股公司，其營運子公司位於美國。本公司為唯一在美國上市，採用Search Fund模式進行收購與建立優秀企業之公開上市公司，並擁有並營運一系列高品質之B2B及B2C服務公司，這些公司為輕資產、成長中、獲利且具持續性收入之企業。Kingsway透過其分散式管理模型、具備才能之經營團隊及稅務優勢之公司結構，致力於每股長期股東價值之複利成長。Kingsway透過兩個應報告分部進行業務運作：Kingsway Search Xcelerator及Extended Warranty。

Kingsway Search Xcelerator包含本公司之子公司，CSuite Financial Partners, LLC（"CSuite"）、Ravix Group, Inc.（"Ravix"）、Secure Nursing Service LLC（"SNS"）、Systems Products International, Inc.（"SPI"）、Digital Diagnostics Inc.（"DDI"）、Image Solutions, LLC（"Image Solutions"）、Roundhouse Electric & Equipment Co., Inc.（"Roundhouse"）、M.L.C. Plumbing, LLC（d/b/a Bud's Plumbing Service，"Bud's Plumbing"）、Advanced Plumbing & Drain, LLC（d/b/a AAA Advanced Plumbing & Drain，"Advanced Plumbing"）及Efficient Plumbing, LLC（d/b/a Southside Plumbing，"Southside Plumbing"）。在本年度2025年財務報告中，"Kingsway Search Xcelerator"或"KSX"一詞用以指稱此分部。
CSuite為一家專業服務公司，透過多種靈活方案，為客戶提供經驗豐富之財務長及其它財務專業人才。這些方案包括對高階財務專業人才之專案、分時及臨時聘僱，財務長導師服務、董事會諮詢服務，以及為客戶全美範圍內之永久聘僱提供高階人才搜尋服務。
Ravix為客戶提供分時模式之外包財務服務及人力資源諮詢服務，服務內容包括有明確終點之專案及持續進行之長期或短期合作，服務範圍遍及美國各地。
SNS為美國各急性醫療機構提供醫療人力服務，主要於加利福尼亞州，服務方式為契約或每日計酬制。
SPI提供專門為全球各類共有財產之管理需求所設計之軟體產品。
DDI為一般急性照護、長期急性照護及住院復健醫院提供24小時7天（"24/7"）心電圖監測服務。透過外包心電圖監測，醫院可消除人員呼叫及人力資源問題，去除現場運作之幹擾，並釋放設施人員直接協助病人照護。DDI目前在
Image Solutions 提供完整的資訊科技管理服務，包括設備銷售、服務及技術支援，主要服務客戶位於北卡羅萊納州、堪薩斯州、喬治亞州、肯塔基州及田納西州。
Roundhouse 提供工業規模的電動馬達解決方案，包括現場維護、廠內修理、測試及新馬達銷售，主要服務中游天然氣輸氣管線運營商及電力公司於 Permian Basin 區域。

Kingsway Skilled Trades 包含 Bud's Plumbing、Advanced Plumbing 及 Southside Plumbing。Kingsway Skilled Trades 提供廣泛的水管服務，包括緊急修理、排水清潔、熱水器安裝及水處理解決方案，主要服務住宅及商業客戶，位於印第安那州埃文斯維爾（Bud's Plumbing）、俄亥俄州克里夫蘭（Advanced Plumbing）及內布拉斯加州奧馬哈（Southside Plumbing）。

Extended Warranty 包含本公司的以下子公司：IWS Acquisition Corporation（"IWS"）、Geminus Holding Company, Inc.（"Geminus"）、PWI Holdings, Inc.（"PWI"）及 Trinity Warranty Solutions LLC（"Trinity"）。在本 2025 年年度報告中，"Extended Warranty" 一詞用以指稱此應報告分部。
IWS 是經許可的機動車輛服務協議公司，並提供經銷商服務的車輛保護服務，透過信用合作社在 28 個州及華盛頓特區分銷給其會員，客戶遍及美國所有 50 個州。
Geminus 主要向美國的二手車買家銷售車輛服務協議，主要透過其子公司 The Penn Warranty Corporation（"Penn"）進行，Penn 透過獨立二手車經銷商及特許車經銷商在 46 個州分銷這些產品。

headings: 本公司尚有擔保債務及併購融資，可能不利於本公司未來取得融資之能力、因應業務變動及履行義務之能力。
利率上升將提高本公司償還現有擔保債務之成本，並可能不利於本公司營運成果。
本公司之營運受債務契約條款之限制，可能限制本公司規劃或因應市場狀況之能力，或滿足資本需求之能力。
本公司可能無法實現投資目標，這可能顯著降低本公司之獲利與流動性。
本公司之業務、財務狀況及營運成果可能因公共衛生危機及國際與國家經濟與產業狀況之變動而受到重大且不利之影響。
全球性軍事衝突及其相關後果可能對本公司營運造成負面影響。
國際貿易政策，包括關稅、制裁及貿易壁壘，可能對本公司之業務、財務狀況、營運成果與前景造成不利影響。
本公司之現金、現金等價物及投資若所存放之金融機構發生問題，可能受到不利影響。
我們已產生美國所得稅用途之淨營業虧損遞延利益，但本公司使用這些淨營業虧損之能力可能受到限制，因本公司無法產生未來應稅所得。
我們已產生美國淨營業虧損（NOLs），但本公司維持及使用這些美國淨營業虧損之能力可能因未來股權變動而受到限制或影響。
本公司稅務利益保護計畫到期，可能增加本公司遭遇根據第382節所定義之股權變動之機率。
本公司僅能將本公司美國淨營業虧損（NOLs）用於未來由本公司所取得之公司產生之應稅所得，若本公司能將取得之公司納入本公司美國合併稅務申報組別。
本公司發行有權優先於普通股之優先股，並可能於未來發行額外之優先股。
若本公司未能遵守保險、證券或其他適用之法律或監管要求，本公司之業務、營運成果、財務狀況或現金流可能受到不利影響。
本公司業務面臨與訴訟相關之風險。
本公司內部控制之重大弱點可能導致本公司合併財務報表中出現重大錯誤。
本公司達成戰略目標的成效高度依賴有效的變革管理。
我們可能面臨困難，無法持續留任本公司持股公司員工。
我們所處的極度競爭環境可能對本公司業務、營運結果或財務狀況產生不利影響。
進行併購活動涉及風險，若我們無法有效管理這些風險，將可能對本公司業務造成重大損害。
本公司擴展保固子公司所遞延的服務費用可能不足，將導致本公司淨收入減少，並可能對本公司財務狀況產生不利影響。
擴展保固對信用合作社及經銷商的依賴，以及本公司對汽車銷售的整體依賴，可能對本公司維持業務的能力產生不利影響。
本公司對有限數量的保固及維護支援客戶與買方的依賴，可能對本公司維持業務的能力產生不利影響。
CSuite 聚焦於服務私募股權支持企業，使其面臨一般合併與收購（"M&A"）活動的風險。
Ravix 對於風投資資助的創業公司之集中，使其面臨風投資金週期之風險。
SNS 若適用之政府法規變更，可能導致成本增加，進而降低其營業收入與獲利能力。
SNS 若無法隨著費率下降而調整護理人員薪資率，其獲利能力可能受到不利影響。
SNS 可能無法招募與留任足夠之高品質護理人員以應對需求。
Image Solutions 可能無法招募與留任足夠之高品質資訊科技專業人員以應對需求。
我們部分業務線之營業收入與成長，依賴持續之客戶留存與重複業務；關鍵客戶流失或重複業務減少，可能對結果造成損害。
Roundhouse 因集中於 Permian Basin 區域及中游天然氣輸氣管運營商與電力公司客戶羣，而面臨區域性與產業特定風險。
Roundhouse 之業務包含設備銷售，可能受到供應鏈限制、交貨延誤與價格壓力之影響。
Roundhouse 面臨提供關鍵場域服務於客戶現場所涉及的固有健康、安全及營運風險。
我們的專業技工作業涉及固有安全風險，可能導致員工受傷、財產損壞、法規責任及營運成本增加。
專業技工客戶需求變動或特定市場客戶集中度的變化，可能對我們的營運結果產生不利影響。
我們的成功取決於我們能否準確評估我們承保的風險並進行定價。
我們的業務依賴關鍵員工，若我們無法留住這些關鍵員工或吸引並留住更多合格人才，將可能對我們的業務產生不利影響。
